summary: fix(settings): read pairing state when v2 supplicant ApproveSignIn mounts
description:
Because:

- A fast v2 approval sets the supplicant state to Complete before
  ApproveSignIn subscribes, so the page stays on approve_signin.
- Under StrictMode the mount-time routing ran twice in development.

This commit:

- Routes Complete or Failed from integration.state when ApproveSignIn mounts.
- Runs that routing once with a useRef flag.
- Adds tests for each state at mount and a StrictMode regression test.

Closes FXA-14793
